newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK CAPITAL BOOST APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK CAPITAL BOOST APPROVED.

text.p: The government said on Thursday that a cabinet meeting approved a decision to boost the share capital of state-run Agricultural bank.
The current share capital of the bank stands at 128 million litas and it will be increased from additional contributions by around 55 million litas.
"Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius is expected to sign a decision later today and the figures might be amended slightly," said Laima Urbshiene, the government advisor on banking.
The final decision is expected at a general shareholders' meeting scheduled for June 6.
The bank said earlier the move was necessary to improve the bank's capital adequacy ratio which was 9.18 percent as of May 1. The Bank of Lithuania's minimum requirement is 10 percent.
The state has 86 percent stake of what is the second largest bank in terms of assets and one of two slated for privatisation.
The bank posted a net profit of 25.5 million litas in 1996 and 11.24 million litas in the first quarter of the year.
